answer_text: Partly. OAP section 8 states that car use should be limited through (c-01)[avec la réalisation de parkings souterrains ou dans le gabarit des constructions] (pdf p.35, printed p.34). It presents underground parking and parking within the building envelope as alternatives, so it does not require underground parking alone. It also calls for shared parking and a reduced number of on-street spaces (c-02)[une recherche de mutualisation des places de stationnement et l'accueil d'un nombre réduit de places de stationnement le long des voies]. The planner's compatibility-binding premise is not confirmed by the OAP text I searched.
discrepancy_note: The planner rationale states that the OAP parking guidance is compatibility-binding. I could not confirm this from the OAP text. Searches for compatib, opposable, conformit and rapport de compatibilit returned only a cover-page reference to a 2017 mise en compatibilité decree on page 1 and an unrelated use of compatible on page 4. The binding-force premise is not supported by the source.
additional_context: The OAP passage is a qualitative orientation that presents parking location as an either-or option (underground or within the building gabarit), so a strict yes/no answer to the boolean question would be misleading and is not forced here. Any numeric parking norms must come from the reglement, not this OAP. Ordinary OAP text contains no stated rule requiring parking to be underground.
